messages:
Anika (People Ops): Quick heads-up — SOC2 evidence collection is going into a strict window next week. All evidence owners must upload artifacts by EOD Friday (UTC) 2026-04-03. Please read the short checklist and upload links below.

Jared (Eng): Ack. Is this the same set as last year or updated?

Anika (People Ops): Updated — we added a small privacy attestation step and a new incident response snapshot for any oncall owners. Link: https://go.redwoodinference.com/soc2-evidence-2026 (confluence).

Maya (Compliance): Important: if you are tagged as an "evidence owner" on the spreadsheet, please: 1) upload the named artifact to the Evidence page, 2) add a single-line summary and a timestamp, 3) confirm in-thread. Missing items will trigger follow-up from audit team.

Sam (Product): Can we get a 24h extension for teams with external vendor docs? Some vendors are slow to produce signed SLA addenda.

Maya (Compliance): We can handle vendor exceptions but we need an OK request by Wednesday EOD with the vendor name and expected delivery date. Send me a DM if sensitive.

compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled: SOC2 evidence uploads due in 7 days. Use /upload-evidence to start.

Priya (Platform): Quick Q: where should infra runbooks go? Last time it was GDrive, now Confluence?

Anika (People Ops): All runbooks should be attached on the Evidence Confluence page under 'Runbooks/Infra' and ALSO linked from the spreadsheet row. This avoids mismatch during review.

Diego (SRE): Uploaded an incident snapshot + runbook. Row 14. Evidence ID: IR-2026-042. Short summary: paging flow, recent postmortem link.

Jared (Eng): Done — deployment config and access matrix uploaded. @Maya please let me know if the format needs tweaks.

Maya (Compliance): Received, Jared — will validate before Friday. If any formatting issues, I'll ping owners directly.

Anika (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Final checklist (TL;DR):
- Upload artifact to Evidence Confluence page (required)
- Add one-line summary + timestamp in the spreadsheet (required)
- Confirm in this thread with row number (helps auditors)
- Request exceptions to Maya by 2026-04-01 EOD

Anika (People Ops): We will run a verification pass Thu-Fri and send final reminders to people with missing items. :bell:

Sam (Product): Can people opt into a short office hours session? 30 min walkthrough of the upload process would help new owners.

Anika (People Ops): Yes — Office hours scheduled: 2026-03-31 16:00 UTC in #help. I'll post the calendar invite shortly.

Jared (Eng): Confirm row 7 updated. Thanks.

Priya (Platform): Uploaded runbook link and added conf version. Row 9. :thumbsup:

Maya (Compliance): Quick note — if you store PII in any artifact, redact before upload or set the Confluence page to restricted and DM me the row.

Diego (SRE): Acknowledged.

Anika (People Ops): Final reminder will go out 48h before deadline. If you're unsure whether you're an evidence owner, check the spreadsheet or ping me.

Jared (Eng): Thanks — doing a final pass today.
